title: Venus in furs
html_source:
Venus in Furs
Author Leopold von Sacher-Masoch
Country Austria
Language German
Publication date 1870
Venus in Furs (German: Venus im Pelz) is a novella by the Austrian author Leopold von Sacher-Masoch, and the best known of his works. The novel draws themes, like female dominance and sadomasochism, and character inspiration heavily from Sacher-Masoch’s own life.
